@ a part with events inside under .down~(2) runs at the even frames: its sums are held two frames
@ a part with events inside under .up~(2) runs twice in each frame: the two runs are the two elements of its output
@ a part with events inside under when~ runs only where the condition holds: its events, its state and its output are those of the runs
render event_part_values.lp_when sr=0x41000000 in c=[true true false true false false true]
@ reset_if~ puts the events inside back: the sum starts again, and the value of an event that did not come after it is T.default()
render event_part_values.lp_reset sr=0x41000000 in r=[false false true false false true]
render event_part_values.even_reset sr=0x41000000 in r=[false false false false true false false]
@ sample_tick() in an event stage of a part is the position: the time of the caller under when~ (stopped frames count), the time divided by 2 under .down~(2)
render event_part_values.tick_when sr=0x41000000 in c=[true false true true false true]
@ a run split in two process calls keeps the last event in the state, and reset puts it back
